description: Snaps an incoming voltage to the nearest note of a scale

params.text: Sets the root note the pitch output is quantised to
Sets the scale the pitch output is quantised to; the last setting leaves the pitch alone
Shifts the quantised pitch by whole octaves

inputs.text: Added to the ROOT knob, 0V to 10V covering the twelve notes
Added to the SCALE knob, 0V to 10V covering every scale
The voltage to be snapped to the scale
Added to the OCTAVE knob, a volt per octave

menu: Inputs Override Knobs — makes the note, scale and octave inputs replace their knobs rather than add to them
